stories.title: Scott Bessent Relocates to Military Base Amid Iranian Threats
stories.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has moved from his home in the Washington, D.C. area to a U.S. military base following threats against his life attributed to Iran. Bessent has been a key figure in the U.S. effort to impose economic sanctions on Iran, making him a target for threats. He is among several U.S. officials who have relocated to military bases due to safety concerns.

stories.title: Russian Ambassador to the US Alexander Darchiev Passes Away at 66
stories.summary: Alexander Darchiev, Russia's ambassador to the United States, has died at the age of 66. The Russian Foreign Ministry announced his sudden passing, describing him as an outstanding diplomat and experienced leader. Further details regarding the circumstances of his death have not been provided.

stories.title: Infant Rescued After Being Buried Alive in Dog Crate in South Carolina
stories.summary: An 11-month-old baby was rescued after being buried alive in a dog crate for approximately 24 hours in South Carolina. The child was found near his father's home, clinging to life and crying. Authorities reported that a towel wrapped around the crate created an air pocket, which likely helped the infant survive. The baby is currently receiving care in a hospital.

stories.title: Spain Experiences First General Strike in 14 Years Amid Housing Crisis
stories.summary: Millions of Spaniards participated in a general strike, the first in 14 years, to protest rising housing costs and stagnant wages. The strike led to significant disruptions across major cities, coinciding with upcoming parliamentary elections. Demonstrators expressed frustration over the affordability of housing, which has become a central issue in the country.

stories.title: Kennedy Family Members Challenge Trump's Memorial Arch Plans at Arlington Cemetery
stories.summary: Nine members of the Kennedy family have filed a lawsuit against the proposed construction of a 250-foot memorial arch by Donald Trump at Arlington National Cemetery. They argue that the arch would disrupt views and cast shadows over the graves of President John F. Kennedy and Senator Robert F. Kennedy. The family seeks to block the project, claiming it would be a denigration of their relatives' final resting places.

Authorities are taking extensive precautions following previous criticisms regarding their response to earlier storms. In neighboring Spain, over 3,000 people have been evacuated due to the risk of flooding from heavy rains and potential dam overflow.

The Kremlin's spokesperson confirmed that this decision is a direct response to France's earlier actions against pro-Russian media figures.

Massie accused Hegseth of conducting military operations against Iran without congressional approval for over 90 days. President Donald Trump expressed support for Hegseth following the vote.
